reviews.title: £2.49 for 3 months then £6.99 for 20gb SIM
reviews.body: The advert said for a 20gb SIM the cost for the first three months was £2.49 and then £6.99 thereafter. I followed the link but at the end the bill came as £6.99. I contacted Lebara. They asked me to send a copy of the advert. I did. They asked me to confirm some security details which I did. I then heard nothing. I have made several phone calls sent several emails all to the response of someone will contact you. I rang again yesterday and was told because I had paid the bill there was nothing they could do. They said I could transfer my number to some other company and then come back and try and get on the correct plan. I copied Rogest Dangre the MD and Stephen Surrock the CEO in my latest email and I actually got an email asking what number I wanted the customer service team to contact me on and what time. I said 12.30pm the next doy on my phone number. Its now 7.30pm.

reviews.title: Patient and helpful support from Devansh
reviews.body:
I had a very positive experience with Devansh from Lebara customer support today. My issue with sending SMS while roaming was a little complicated and wasn’t fully resolved during the chat, but Devansh was patient, polite and genuinely tried to help throughout the whole conversation. He took the time to check my account, explain the possible roaming and PAYG options, and stayed with me while we went through the troubleshooting steps.

What I appreciated most was his attitude — he was friendly, respectful and made the whole conversation feel much more personal rather than just a routine support chat. Thank you, Devansh, for your patience and help today. You definitely made a good impression.

reviews.title: URGENT LEGAL NOTICE: 6+ MONTHS OF UNRESOLVED COMPLAINTS, OVER 64 EMAILS IGNORED & UNLAWFUL MONTHLY DISCONNECTIONS OF A VULNERABLE CARER (Ref: CAS-2769234-C8K4D2 / Order ID: G0041102869)
reviews.body: Lebara is systematically breaching its contract, ignoring legal obligations, and endangering a vulnerable customer caring for critically ill parents. Despite an extensive chain of over 64 emails and more than 6 months of continuous complaints, Lebara refuses to resolve these issues and repeatedly sends generic automated responses while cutting off vital phone services every single month.   The monthly cycle of unlawful contract cancellations and customer service hostility remains ongoing:March 2026: Purchased a 50GB Uswitch plan (£3.18/mo). Lebara failed to port my number, sent the wrong SIM hardware, mis-sold a pricier plan, and three agents (Moin, Rulin, Zeeshaw) hung up on me. Lebara ignored my formal complaint for nearly a month.   June 2026: Service cut off with no notice. Lebara formally confirmed in writing on 12/06/26 that a 50GB plan was activated at no cost for 6 months to resolve the complaint.   July 2026: Service cut off again. Agent Akshay attempted to blackmail me into deleting my factual Trustpilot reviews under threat of removing my credit. After I refused to be coerced, my reviews were deleted, and Lebara re-confirmed a £48 credit balance and 50GB plan scheduled to auto-renew.   August 2026: Service cut off again on 11/08/26 despite my remaining credit. Agent Urvi demanded payment details and hung up when I asked when service would be restored. Agent Rosita subsequently refused reactivation and hung up as well.   September 2026: Service cut off again on 10/09/26. Agent Harshal demanded payment despite my existing £48 credit balance and placed me on hold when I challenged him with Lebara's written email evidence.   Current Status: Over 64 emails have been sent across 6+ months, yet Lebara continues to send useless generic replies instead of resolving the issue or preventing recurring disconnections.   Lebara is in direct violation of the UK Consumer Rights Act and Ofcom’s General Conditions on Customer Vulnerability.   FINAL NOTICE & MANDATORY ACTION: Lebara management must immediately restore my contract on the agreed terms, ensure my £48 account credit is honored, permanently cease these monthly disconnections, and provide a formal compensation offer. This entire history, including all 64+ emails, recorded calls, and evidence of review suppression, is being submitted directly to Ofcom and the Communications Ombudsman.

reviews.title: Good whilst it lasted
reviews.body:
I have been with Lebara a number of years but it does seem that over that time customer service has fallen off a cliff. It's cheap and using Vodafone network usually reliable so OK? Yes until you have a problem.
My recent experience has been that customer service has declined so that you receive apologies but not necessarily a solution. Agents seem to be rushing to end the call not wanting to wait while you verify the "solution". 
Even complaints seem to be resolved by explaining "that's the way it is". 
I had several numbers with them but have begun moving them away. The other established operators are responding to the pricing challenge and are USUALLY better a problem resolution. Hence my move.
Incidentally in terms of cheap it is relative. I spend time in Bulgaria and while there I checked Lebara prices. In the UK 50GB is £15, in Bulgaria 60GB is EUR7.99 (£7 ish) 
For me, it was good whilst it lasted.
